summary: This is a YAML configuration file that sets up reveal.js, which is a presentation framework. It's telling the presentation to display slide numbers in the format 'current/total' (like '3/10') at the bottom of each slide.

explanations.3: The 'c/t' notation means 'current slide number slash total slides' — so if you're on slide 3 of 10, it will show '3/10'. This is the format for displaying progress through your presentation.
